entities.summary: Meiya Tireira is a Malian women's basketball player for Valencia Basket in the Spanish Women's League. A member of the Mali women's national basketball team, Tireira competed in all 5 of Mali's matches at the 2008 Summer Olympics, scoring a total of 16 points and grabbing 19 rebounds.
